description:
FILED s517a (Opus, 2026-10-15), found re-causing the JSON-PP board rows after #3242.

A STASH ALIAS -- `*A:: = *B::;` -- makes package A the SAME symbol table as B
in perl: every sub, @ISA and isa() answer of B is A's.  PCL ignores it:

    package B0; sub hi { "hi" } package A0; *A0:: = *B0::;
    package main; my $o = bless {}, "A0";
    print $o->isa("B0") ? 1 : 0, " ", (eval { $o->hi } // "none"), "\n";

    perl 5.40.3: 1 hi        PCL: 0 none

(scratch/s517a/pr/stash.pl.)  Cost: JSON-PP-4.18 t/118_boolean_values.t rows
6, 7, 10, 11 (`*Dummy::True:: = *JSON::PP::Boolean::;`) -- blessed as "#3242
probable" until s517a; #3242 (stable booleans) shipped and they still fail,
this is their cause.  A stash is a CL package in PCL, so the alias needs a
package-name redirection at bless / method resolution / isa (or a
package-nickname), not a symbol copy.


=== DONE (s522b, commit 4d55270f (rebased; was 1502c67d), the s522 ruling (c)) ===
`*A:: = *B::` lowers to (p-stash-assign "A" (p-stash "B")) via a new p-setf arm; it records A -> B once in *p-stash-aliases* and in the stash memo *pcl-stash-table*, so %pcl-find-package (dispatch, can, SUPER::, symbolic refs, p-stash) answers B's package with no per-call test; %pcl-normalize-pkg (isa) and p-bless (ref = B, Fable's correction) consult the table only when it is non-empty.  Compile-time names stay with A (r4 none, r6 undef, as perl).  BAR: Fable's b3 probe 7 rows = perl; JSON-PP 118_boolean_values.t 30/0, its four #3321 rows out; guard row 9 of Pl/t/stash-hash-01.t.  RESUME FIX (s522b resumed s523, commit f33adcf3): SUPER:: walks the  of the package its code was COMPILED in, past the alias -- `BEGIN { *Mover:: = *Mover2:: } package Mover; @ISA = q(door); Mover->SUPER::dohtem` had lost perl-tests/method.t 43/44 (t/op/method.t "SUPER inside moved package"); guard stash-hash-01 row 11.  The unimplemented `%A:: = LIST` / `*A:: = *glob` writes now ANNOUNCE (op/stash.t #128086 + `%A::=""` rows edited in with the cause).
subject: a stash alias *A:: = *B:: is ignored: A objects do not see B methods or isa (JSON-PP 118_boolean_values.t rows 6/7/10/11)
